note: Reviewed corrections to district_id joins in bangladesh.geojson. Each polygon's name is shared by upazilas in two districts, and the upstream name matcher attached it to the wrong one. The corrected district is the ADM2 district (same geoBoundaries release) that contains the polygon's interior point, and it matches the known location of the named place. The build fails on any disagreement not listed here, and on any listed correction that is no longer needed.
